notes: All images are CC0 1.0 and verified on each Wikimedia Commons file page. Most are classic Unsplash CC0 uploads mirrored on Commons; waypoint-systems is a USDA Forest Service Alaska Region aerial and waypoint-price is by Bernard Spragg (Flickr), both CC0. Processed with sharp: auto-orient, max 2400px on the long edge, metadata stripped, mozjpeg q70-82.

photos.description: Matterhorn and the Zermatt glaciers under a vivid pink, coral and violet sky, painted at dusk but it reads as dawn. Epic, bold and calm. Sky streaks lead the eye toward the peak.
photos.creator: Sam Ferrara
photos.title: Sunset over Matterhorn (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The top 55% is open, streaked pink and violet sky, safe for a big white headline (add a dark scrim for AA). Keep CTAs above the ridgeline. The peak sits right of centre.

photos.slot: Beat 2 THE TERRAIN: fog over a ridge
photos.description: A dark ridge plunges into a golden, back-lit sea of clouds, with teal shadows. It feels uncharted and mysterious, and warm.
photos.creator: Anton Repponen
photos.title: Golden mountain (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The top band of teal clouds and the lower-right cloud mass are both calm. Use white text with a light scrim, or place text in the top-left third.

photos.slot: Beat 3 THE ROUTE: background behind the 3D topo route
photos.description: A footpath winds through golden-green Patagonian steppe toward the snow-capped Torres del Paine spires (Chile). It is literally a route drawn across terrain.
photos.creator: Guillermo Riquelme
photos.title: Parque Nacional Torres del Paine, Chile (Unsplash hFBwVNkEnWg)
photos.textSafeArea: The upper-right sky is bright white cloud, safe for dark text. The lower half is busy with grass texture, so overlay a tinted panel there.

photos.description: A lone hiker stands on a granite overlook above the deep-blue Lysefjord (Norway), under a vivid blue sky full of cumulus. It reads as 'see the whole landscape'. The figure is tiny, seen from behind and not identifiable.
photos.creator: Carl Cerstrand
photos.title: Lysefjorden, Norway (Unsplash nyghAPuJQC8)
photos.textSafeArea: The top 40% is blue sky with white clouds, safe for dark text on a white card, or white text with a shadow. The figure is in the upper-left, so avoid covering it.

photos.description: A stone cairn on a golden, sun-raked hillside at golden hour, with a long shadow and deep-blue sky. Balance and judgement.
photos.creator: Bernard Spragg
photos.title: The Stone Cairn. (15820921483)
photos.textSafeArea: The right half (an empty golden slope) and the top sky band are calm. The cairn sits left of centre.

photos.description: A wildflower superbloom: bands of vivid yellow wildflowers stretch across a vast green plain to banded hills. Scale and open opportunity.
photos.creator: Tim Mossholder
photos.title: Painted Hills (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The top 18% is pale cyan sky, safe for dark text. The plain in the lower half is also calm enough for a tinted card.

photos.slot: Waypoint 4 SYSTEMS: glacier / river network from above
photos.description: An aerial view of a branching Alaskan glacier system: ice tongues, moraines and meltwater lakes under blue sky. A network that flows. The aircraft frame was cropped from the bottom.
photos.creator: Forest Service Alaska Region, USDA
photos.title: Glacier Bay National Park Aerial Survey La Perouse Glacier-Alaska
photos.textSafeArea: The top 22% is blue sky and cloud, good for white text with a shadow. The lower-left grey moraine is calm.

photos.slot: Waypoint 5 TEAM: people on the trail together
photos.description: Two hikers, seen from behind, descend a rugged golden ridge into hazy blue Himalayan-style valleys. A team on the climb, with no faces visible.
photos.creator: Galen Crout
photos.title: Adventurous Mountain Hikes (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The top 35% is soft hazy sky, very safe for dark or white text. The figures are on the left and centre-right.

photos.slot: Beat 4 THE GUIDE: background behind Anurag's photo and story
photos.description: A wide alpine valley seen from a high forested ridge: snow-streaked peaks, a braided river below, bright cumulus sky. Explorer's-eye view.
photos.creator: Scott Webb
photos.title: Green valley in the white mountains (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The top 45% is bright blue sky with white cumulus, so put dark text on a white card or use a scrim. The forest in the lower-right is dark, good for white text.

photos.description: Bryce Canyon hoodoos: saturated coral, terracotta and cream rock spires with green pines. Hot, bold colour.
photos.creator: Luca Bravo
photos.title: Bryce Canyon National Park, United States (Unsplash ESus7wfHOas)
photos.textSafeArea: The frame is busy edge to edge. Use a bottom gradient scrim, or a solid label chip for the card text.

photos.description: Inside a Mendenhall Glacier ice cave (Alaska): electric glacier-blue scalloped ice, very saturated and dramatic.
photos.creator: Steve Halama
photos.title: Mendenhall Glacier, Juneau, United States (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The dark lower-left corner suits white text. Otherwise use a bottom gradient scrim.

photos.description: Green and magenta aurora over an autumn-orange forest line, mirrored in a still lake. Vivid, otherworldly.
photos.creator: Alan Labisch
photos.title: Colorful aurora borealis (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The upper-left sky (a soft green-violet gradient) is calm, good for white text.

photos.description: Fitz Roy's granite spires and glacier above a turquoise alpine lake under a deep-blue sky (Patagonia). Rugged and pristine.
photos.creator: Arto Marttinen
photos.title: Fitz Roy (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The top-right is clean deep-blue sky, ideal for white text.

photos.slot: Beat 6 FROM THE TRAIL: aside plate; v3 /subscribe hero and the /start "learn" door
photos.description: A winding path through a sunlit pine forest in early autumn: bronze undergrowth, tall trunks, soft blue sky. A quiet thinking walk.
photos.creator: Josephine Wentholt
photos.title: Twisting path in an autumn forest (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The centre-top sky gap between the trunks is bright. Text works best on a cream or white panel over the left or right third.

photos.description: Sunrise from Roy's Peak (New Zealand): a golden, snow-dusted ridge leads up to a blazing sun over the lake and cloud. Triumphant arrival.
photos.creator: Jingwei Ke
photos.title: Sunrise at Roy's Peak (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The upper-left sky (pale lavender) and the right side around the sun are bright, so use dark text or a dark-glass CTA card on the left. The ridge runs diagonally from the bottom-left.

photos.description: The Sassolungo massif in the Dolomites: a white snow and meltwater line winds down from the peaks like a route on a map.
photos.creator: Raul Taciu
photos.title: Passo Sella, Dolomites (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The top 30% is flat pale grey-blue sky, very safe for dark text.

photos.description: Torres del Paine: the Cuernos peaks wreathed in cloud above a turquoise lake and golden steppe. Classic far-off expedition country.
photos.creator: Olga Stalska
photos.title: Torres del Paine National Park, Chile (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The upper-left cloud bank is bright and calm, good for dark text or white text on a scrim.

photos.description: A glowing lime-green tent on a snowy summit at night, with valley city lights far below. Basecamp: let's talk.
photos.creator: Sam X
photos.title: Green tent on a snow covered mountain (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The top 35% is a near-black night sky, ideal for white text and form chrome.

photos.description: The Wanaka tree standing alone in a mirror-still lake at twilight, under a violet-to-pink sky. Calm and reflective.
photos.creator: Ken Cheung
photos.title: Wanaka, New Zealand (Unsplash KonWFWUaAuk)
photos.textSafeArea: The top 40% sky and the bottom 35% water are both smooth gradients, very safe for white text.

photos.description: Looking straight down chalk-white sea cliffs into a vast, wind-textured cobalt sea. The trail ends here.
photos.creator: Callum Wale
photos.title: White Cliffs of Dover, United Kingdom (Unsplash R3C-jKN7vIU)
photos.textSafeArea: The right two-thirds is open blue sea, ideal for white text.

photos.slot: v3 /start hero (PhotoId start-matterhorn). Never on the same page as basecamp-hero
photos.description: A closer Matterhorn with a cloud banner under a pink and orange sunset sky. Same shoot as basecamp-hero, so don't use both on one page.
photos.creator: Sam Ferrara
photos.title: Matterhorn sunset 2016 (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The top 40% is streaked pink sky, safe for white text.

photos.description: Endless layered blue mountain ridges fading into haze. Pure glacier-blue tones, minimal and mysterious.
photos.creator: Paul Gilmore
photos.title: Blue mountain folds (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The entire frame is calm. The top 30% is the lightest, good for dark or white text.

photos.description: A Landmannalaugar (Iceland) panorama: banded rhyolite mountains above a flat green plain, blue sky with streaky cloud. 3:1 banner.
photos.creator: Quinn Nietfeld
photos.title: Meadow in the Icelandic mountains (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The top-right sky and the bottom green meadow are calm.

photos.description: The Na Pali coast (Kauai): jungle-green ridges drop to a turquoise surf line, with big white clouds.
photos.creator: Josh Austin
photos.title: NaPali Coast (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The upper-right cloud and sky is bright, so use dark text, or a scrim for white.

photos.description: A tall, balanced stone stack on desert granite boulders under a mackerel-cloud blue sky (Joshua Tree style). Portrait 2:3.
photos.creator: Nick Tong
photos.title: Pebble Stack (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The top 55% is blue sky with small clouds, safe for dark text on a card, or white text with a shadow.

photos.slot: v3 /community hero (PhotoId community-golden; also guide-ridge) and the /start "room" door
photos.description: Silhouetted mountain ridges in layers of orange haze with god-rays (bottom fence band cropped out). It has visible film grain, so use it at ≤1600px or under an overlay.
photos.creator: Sergey Pesterev
photos.title: Sunset in the mountains (Unsplash)
photos.textSafeArea: The top 35% is a smooth orange sky, very safe for white or dark text.
